beats.say: Which structure normally acts as the heart's natural pacemaker?
It's easy to mix up the SA node and the AV node. The names sound alike, and both are groups of pacemaker cells.

claims.quote: The signal begins in a group of cells, called pacemaker cells, located in the sinoatrial (SA) node in the right atrium.
The electrical signal then moves down to a group of pacemaker cells called the atrioventricular (AV) node, located between the atria and the ventricles.

beats.say: But the signal starts in the SA node, in the right atrium, and the SA node controls the rate and rhythm of your heartbeat.

claims.quote: The signal starts with cells in the sinoatrial (SA) node that cause the heart to beat.
located in the sinoatrial (SA) node in the right atrium
The SA node controls the rate and rhythm of your heartbeat.

beats.say: The signal travels through the atria, then down to the AV node, where it slows down slightly, allowing the ventricles time to finish filling with blood.

claims.quote: The electrical signal travels through the atria, causing them to pump blood into the ventricles.
The electrical signal then moves down to a group of pacemaker cells called the atrioventricular (AV) node
Here the signal slows down slightly, allowing the ventricles time to finish filling with blood.

beats.say: From the AV node, the bundle of His extends into the septum between the ventricles and conducts the impulses to them. Purkinje fibers make up the terminal portion of the conduction system.

claims.quote: Small band of specialized CARDIAC MUSCLE fibers that originates in the ATRIOVENTRICULAR NODE and extends into the membranous part of the interventricular septum.
conducts the electrical impulses to the HEART VENTRICLES
Modified cardiac muscle fibers composing the terminal portion of the heart conduction system.

beats.say: The ventricles contract and pump blood out of the heart, and the process starts all over again in the SA node.

claims.quote: causing them to contract and pump blood out of your heart.
The ventricles relax, and the heartbeat process starts all over again in the SA node.

beats.say: The trick: S for start. The heartbeat starts in the SA node, the pacemaker of the heart.

claims.quote: The signal starts with cells in the sinoatrial (SA) node that cause the heart to beat.
the heartbeat process starts all over again in the SA node
Because it establishes the basic rhythm of the heartbeat, it is called the pacemaker of the heart

beats.say: Normally, the heart's natural pacemaker is the sinoatrial node, the SA node.

claims.quote: it is called the pacemaker of the heart
The first part of the conduction system is the sinoatrial node.
Normally, the electrical signal that makes your heart beat travels from the top of your heart to the bottom.
